item.title: What a manufacturing rollout taught me about NetSuite work orders
item.description: Lessons from bringing work orders, routings, BOMs and costing into NetSuite for a discrete manufacturer: what to build first and what breaks costing later.

item.title: Five governance mistakes that take down a SuiteScript
item.description: The usage-limit mistakes I see most often in SuiteScript, why each one fails only after go-live, and the fix for each.
